7. mean one-way delay minus the minimum one-way delay within the window (ms, non-negative)
8. mean packet inter-arrival time (ms)
9. packet jitter (ms)
10. packet loss ratio (fraction between 0 and 1)
11. mean number of lost packets per loss event
12. share of video packets (fraction)
13. share of audio packets (fraction)
14. share of probing packets (fraction)
